summary: - **[key4hep/k4geo#625](https://github.com/key4hep/k4geo/pull/625)** — Sensitive-detector types (`calorimeter` or `tracker`) are now hard-coded in the geometry constructors, and every `<sensitive type="..."/>` tag is removed from the compact XML files, including ALLEGRO, IDEA, CLD and FCChh. One consequence is that the FCChh tail catcher now produces tracker hits instead of calorimeter hits; the archived FCCDetectors drivers used by `FCCee_o2_v03` need the same update before those compacts will load.

- **[key4hep/CLDConfig#98](https://github.com/key4hep/CLDConfig/pull/98)** — The `CONFIG` dictionary in `CLDReconstruction.py` is replaced by command-line arguments (`--calorimeterIntegrationTimeWindow`, `--overlay`, including `--overlay=Skip`, `--vertexUnconstrained`, `--outputMode`), and `--native` combined with LCIO output is now rejected. `BEAM_SPOT_SIZES` is updated to the luminous-region sizes from the 2025 FCC Feasibility Study, which changes reconstruction output compared with earlier productions.

- **[key4hep/EDM4hep#534](https://github.com/key4hep/EDM4hep/pull/534)** — Adds `MutableSimCalorimeterHit::addMCParticleContribution`, which attaches a `CaloHitContribution` and adds its energy to the hit in a single call, so merged hits (e.g. in `OverlayTiming`) stay consistent with their contributions. The documentation now states that hit energy is the sum of all contributions with no time selection applied, so time windows must be handled in digitization.

- **[key4hep/k4ActsTracking#109](https://github.com/key4hep/k4ActsTracking/pull/109)** — Adds `VertexFindingAlg`, an ACTS Adaptive Multi-Vertex Finder for primary-vertex reconstruction from existing EDM4hep tracks. It supports configurable track selection, a beam-spot constraint and annealing, and stores weighted vertex–track links. A CLD configuration tuned for FCC-ee beam conditions is included and has been validated against LCFIPlus.

- **[key4hep/k4ActsTracking#137](https://github.com/key4hep/k4ActsTracking/pull/137)** — `CKFTrackingAlg` now takes each hit's time resolution from its EDM4hep 1.2 time error, for both 4D CKF measurements and the seeding time cuts. `HitTimeResolutions` is kept only as a fallback for older files, and a hit with neither a time error nor a fallback value raises an error.

- **[key4hep/k4Reco#74](https://github.com/key4hep/k4Reco/pull/74)** — `DDPlanarDigi` now stores the per-layer time resolution used for smearing as the tracker hit's `timeError` (EDM4hep 1.2). Downstream time-aware tracking can therefore use it directly.

- **[key4hep/k4Reco#75](https://github.com/key4hep/k4Reco/pull/75)** — Fixes a crash in `GaudiTrkUtils` for trackers with detector ID > 20, an assumption inherited from LCIO. This affects the silicon wrappers of ALLEGRO and IDEA in conformal-tracking reconstruction.

- **[AIDASoft/DD4hep#1703](https://github.com/AIDASoft/DD4hep/pull/1703)** — Adds a `PlacementPathCache` and uses it when building the SurfaceManager maps. For ALLEGRO_o1_v04 the first surface-map build drops from 350 s to 1.8 s, which removes most of the reconstruction `initialize` time previously charged to the first `DDPlanarDigi`.

- **[key4hep/k4GaudiPandora#51](https://github.com/key4hep/k4GaudiPandora/pull/51)** — `DDPandoraPFANewAlgorithm` gains theta–energy (2D) electromagnetic and hadronic energy corrections, read from JSON tables produced by the calibration scripts via `ElectromagneticThetaEnergyCorrectionFile` and `HadronicThetaEnergyCorrectionFile`. Existing configurations are unchanged, and nlohmann_json becomes a new dependency.

- **[key4hep/k4RecTracker#114](https://github.com/key4hep/k4RecTracker/pull/114)** — The hit-to-MC-particle matching in `TracksFromGenParticles` no longer rescans every hit for each particle, giving about an 80× speedup. The loop had been one of the main hotspots in ALLEGRO digi/reco of ZH events.

- **[hep-fcc/FCC-config#410](https://github.com/HEP-FCC/FCC-config/pull/410)** — The ALLEGRO o1_v03 and o2_v01 simulation recipes now use the ddsim steering file. Without it, gaseous-tracker hits below 1 keV were discarded and hits were merged, which breaks the digitization.

- **[key4hep/k4Opt#32](https://github.com/key4hep/k4Opt/pull/32)** — Introduces `k4opt optimize`, which runs a detector-design study of a problem with Optuna's TPE sampler and supports resuming. Each trial is evaluated and recorded with the same run layout as `k4opt evaluate`, and Optuna is confined to a single adapter module.
